items.q: How long does the consulting process take?
items.a: The timeline depends on the service scope, application deadlines and documents you have prepared. Your needs, schedule and deliverables are clarified before work begins.
We can review your target country and programme in the initial consultation. The scope depends on current application requirements, your timeline and your needs.

items.q: Which tools do you use for statistical analysis?
items.a: SPSS, R, Python, AMOS, SmartPLS, NVivo and Stata for quantitative and qualitative analyses.

The client writes the text; we provide guidance on methods, structure, language and statistics. We do not write or submit theses or assignments on a student’s behalf. Support is scoped according to your institution’s academic integrity rules.
Fees depend on the service, scope, delivery schedule and level of support required. The scope and fee are set out in a written proposal before work begins.
